snare-snake.board.summary: Critters caught: {caught, number} / {total, number}, {movesLeft, plural, one {# move} other {# moves}} left
snare-snake.goal: Catch every critter before your moves run out.
snare-snake.how-to-play.step-1: Swipe to steer the snake one cell at a time.
snare-snake.how-to-play.step-2: Critters freeze when the snake is next to them.
snare-snake.how-to-play.step-3: Bump into your own body to close a loop.
snare-snake.how-to-play.step-4: Critters in or next to the loop are caught, and the loop uses up its segments.
snare-snake.name: Snare Snake
snare-snake.tagline: Loop the snake. Snare the critters.
snare-snake.tutorial.step-1: Swipe to steer the snake into the gap.
snare-snake.tutorial.step-2: Keep going: the critters freeze beside you.
snare-snake.tutorial.step-3: Now bump into your body to close the loop!
snare-snake.tutorial.step-4: Snared! Catch the rest before your moves run out.
